title: Shared task editor
testKey: Create a task with a title, then select it and change its owner or status. Try saving with a blank title once; the editor should show an error and leave the shared tasks unchanged.
html:
TASK EDITOR

Create or edit shared work

Creating new task
css: .editor{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#101722;color:#edf3fa;border:1px solid #29394e;border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.editor header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.kicker{margin:0 0 3px;color:#91a5bf;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em}.editor h2{margin:0;font-size:22px}.new-btn,.save{appearance:none;border:1px solid #3b5575;border-radius:10px;background:#1a2a3e;color:#eef4fb;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.save{background:#244f83;border-color:#3f79b8}.editor-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,.8fr) minmax(260px,1.5fr);gap:14px;margin-top:16px}.editor aside,.editor form{background:#151f2d;border:1px solid #28394f;border-radius:13px;padding:13px}.editor label{display:grid;gap:5px;margin-bottom:10px}.editor label>span{color:#98abc2;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.editor input,.editor select{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;border:1px solid #31455f;border-radius:9px;background:#101925;color:#edf3fa;padding:9px 10px}.shared-list{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-top:12px;max-height:240px;overflow:auto}.shared-row{padding:8px 9px;border-radius:9px;background:#1a2636}.shared-row strong{display:block;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:12px}.shared-row span{color:#90a5be;font-size:10px}.error{min-height:18px;margin:2px 0 8px;color:#ffaaa7;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}.mode{color:#9eb1c8;font-size:11px}@media(max-width:650px){.editor-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
js: const $=s=>root.querySelector(s);const select=$('[data-task-select]'),title=$('[data-title]'),owner=$('[data-owner]'),status=$('[data-status]'),due=$('[data-due]'),error=$('[data-error]'),mode=$('[data-mode]');let selectedId='';const taskId=t=>String(t.id??t.taskId??'');const dueOf=t=>t.dueDate||t.due||'';const loadTask=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const t=tasks.find(x=>taskId(x)===selectedId);if(!t){selectedId='';select.value='';title.value='';owner.value='';status.value='Todo';due.value='';mode.textContent='Creating new task';return;}title.value=t.title||'';owner.value=t.owner||t.assignee||'';status.value=t.status||'Todo';if(![...status.options].some(o=>o.value===status.value)){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=status.value;o.textContent=status.value;status.appendChild(o);status.value=t.status;}due.value=String(dueOf(t)).slice(0,10);mode.textContent='Editing '+(t.title||'task');};const render=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const keep=selectedId;select.innerHTML='<option value="">New task</option>';tasks.forEach((t,i)=>{const id=taskId(t)||('index-'+i);const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=id;o.textContent=t.title||'Untitled task';select.appendChild(o);});if(keep&&[...select.options].some(o=>o.value===keep)){selectedId=keep;select.value=keep;}else if(keep){selectedId='';select.value='';}const list=$('[data-shared-list]');list.innerHTML='';tasks.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='shared-row';const strong=document.createElement('strong');strong.textContent=t.title||'Untitled task';const meta=document.createElement('span');meta.textContent=(t.owner||t.assignee||'Unassigned')+' · '+(t.status||'Todo');row.append(strong,meta);list.appendChild(row);});loadTask();};select.addEventListener('change',()=>{selectedId=select.value;error.textContent='';loadTask();});$('[data-new]').addEventListener('click',()=>{selectedId='';select.value='';error.textContent='';loadTask();title.focus();});$('[data-form]').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const clean=title.value.trim();if(!clean){error.textContent='Title is required.';title.focus();return;}error.textContent='';const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];let next;if(selectedId){next=tasks.map(t=>taskId(t)===selectedId?{...t,title:clean,owner:owner.value.trim(),status:status.value,dueDate:due.value}:t);}else{const activeProjectId=api.getState('activeProjectId');const id='task-'+Date.now().toString(36);const created={id,title:clean,owner:owner.value.trim(),status:status.value,dueDate:due.value};if(activeProjectId!=null)created.projectId=activeProjectId;next=[...tasks,created];selectedId=id;}api.setState('tasks',next);api.log(4,(selectedId?'Saved ':'Created ')+clean);});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
